limitations: GUI 11-item acceptance still requires the user to send messages in the desktop GUI; only preflight is machine-verified.
Held-out NL benchmark uses one model and one run with no temperature/seed control; labels are single-author; exact-topic scoring is strict.
Task checkpoints: explicit only; no automatic conversation compaction/native context replacement; conversation locators unverified.
First task-save creates an optional table; dev1 then refuses that database (explicit compatibility boundary).
recall is lexical, not semantic; character budget is not a token budget.
Logical deletion, not physical erasure; expiry is read-time filtering.
No remote CI / Windows/Linux validation; local macOS + Python 3.11.7, clean wheel test on 3.12.
Independent audit GO covers the dev1 core release; dev2 features have maintainer/GPT evidence, not a new external audit.
Global cross-project auto memory remains a prompt convention, not an enforced hook.

heldout_nl.note: new fictional held-out set; independent model; exact-topic scoring is strict; not used for tuning; not a product NLU benchmark
